scenes.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: image 1, an existing complete game background. Images 2 and 3 are actual Arknights client dormitory material atlases: reference only for graphic treatment, NOT a collage to paste. Image 4 is a stylized miniature room reference. Completely repaint image 1 in Arknights BASE / DORMITORY miniature environment aesthetic to fit chibi operator sprites. Strong change required: simplify into broad clean matte color planes, crisp fine dark contour lines, hand-painted 2-3 tone shading, beveled modular furniture, muted ivory / cool gray / charcoal surfaces and sparse amber functional lights, utilitarian angular housings and safety accents. Eliminate gritty realistic photographic textures, excessive rust, wet cinematic reflections, photoreal lighting, giant cathedral architecture, depth haze. Keep theme recognizable but reduce visual scale drastically: in a 2172x724 image every HUMAN DOOR is only 130 pixels high, every desk is 55 pixels high, chairs 70 pixels, server cabinet 110 pixels; around half the old prop scale. Camera pulled back to show compact chibi-compatible facilities. Wide single continuous 3:1 panoramic scene 2172x724, strict side elevation cutaway, no isometric camera. Entire flat unobstructed walking surface lies exactly at 74% image height (y536), below it a simple muted structural cutaway; this is the character foot contact line, not the back edge of a deep floor. Keep the full scene unique, do not tile or mirror rooms. Environmental details behind walking strip are readable and modest, far skyline if any is a minimal graphic silhouette. A small investigation prop at x22% of total width with its base at the walking line; match its existing narrative identity. No people, no UI, no text, no red gates, no drawn gameplay platforms, no glowing secret markers. Output full finished opaque game background, not atlas or comparison sheet. Theme details: Snowy elevated highway maintenance road, a compact closed toll kiosk at x22% with patrol clipboard, short rails, blocky cold gray bridge supports, simplified distant winter city, clean geometric snow caps and a few yellow maintenance crates.
